theorem thm_7_1_4_odd {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (hodd : Odd q) (hq : q ≤ 150000)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : |δ| ≤ 600000 / q) :
    ‖Schar χ (fun n => ((Λ n * etaPlus (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (δ / x) -
        (if q = 1 then 𝓕 (fun u => (etaPlus u : ℂ)) (-δ) * x else 0)‖ ≤
      ((7.5e-8 + 7.7e6 / √x) / √q) * x :=

note: Lean proves the odd/even statements only for x ≥ 4.9·10²⁶ with |E| ≤ (7.5·10⁻⁸ + 7.7·10⁶/√x)/√q, implied by the book; its separate q = 1 bound 10⁻¹⁸ + 6.24·10⁶/√x is incomparable with the book's sharper q = 1 clause. Erratum: In the Sec. 9.6 proof for general q (expform.tex:2233-2239, book p.196), (9 + 11*1.2e6/q)x^{-1} is rewritten as 9/sqrt(x) + 1.32e6/(q sqrt(x)) inside (...)/sqrt(x); the coefficient is 11*1.2e6 = 1.32e7. (checked by `scripts/checks/theorem_7_1_4.py`).
